title: LightningComponentResource - Tooling API
description: Represents a Lightning web component resource, such as HTML markup, JavaScript code, a CSS file, an SVG resource, or an XML configuration file. Available in API version 45.0 and later.

Format.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Format.description: The format of the resource. The possible values are: css html js json svg xml

LightningComponentBundleId.description: The ID of the bundle containing the resource.

ManageableState.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ManageableState.description: Indicates the manageable state of the specified component that is contained in a package: beta deleted deprecated deprecatedEditable installed installedEditable released unmanaged

Source.description: The contents of the definition. This is all the markup or code for the definition.

special_access_rules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.
